title: IAM policies: JSON permissions and evaluation

kcs.statement: An IAM policy is a JSON document whose statements each give an Effect (Allow or Deny), the Actions, the Resources, and optional Conditions.
Identity-based policies attach to users, groups or roles, while resource-based policies attach to a resource such as an S3 bucket and name which principals may access it.
IAM denies every request by default, an explicit Allow grants access, and an explicit Deny in any applicable policy overrides any Allow.
